## CyrenaComponentsCoreComponent

**Selector:** `app-cyrena-components-core`
**Route:** `/developer/components`
**Feature:** `developer`

### Purpose
Documentation page for the `Cyrena.Components.Core` NuGet package — the Blazor component library providing UI contracts, base classes, and extension methods for building UI components that integrate with Cyréna's kernel-scoped services.

### Template Structure
- **Overview** — Package description, version (`0.5.0`), target framework (`.NET 10.0`), namespaces
- **Contracts** — `IDisplayService`, `IShortcut`, `IToolbarComponent`, `IViewStartProvider`
- **Models** — `KernelComponentBase`, `ViewStart`
- **Attributes** — `KernelInjectAttribute`
- **Options** — `ComponentOptions`, `ComponentOptionsExtensions`, `CodeLanguages`
- **Extension Methods** — `CyrenaBuilderExtensions`, `CyrenaKernelBuilderExtensions`, `ComponentBaseExtensions`
- **Shared Blazor Components** — `CodeInput.razor`, `ConnectionSelector.razor`, `PluginSelector.razor`
- **Usage for Extension Developers** — Four C# examples (toolbar, shortcut, settings, view start provider)
- **Package Information** — PackageId, Version, Authors, Description, Title, Repository, ProjectUrl

### Data Arrays (driven by TypeScript)
- `namespaces: string[]` — 5 namespace badges
- `displayMethods: DisplayMethod[]` — 8 rows for IDisplayService method table
- `languageMappings: LanguageMapping[]` — 9 rows for CodeLanguages table
- `settingsOverloads: SettingsOverload[]` — 3 rows for ComponentOptionsExtensions table
- `builderSettingsOverloads: BuilderOverload[]` — 3 rows for CyrenaBuilderExtensions table
- `codeInputParams`, `connectionSelectorParams`, `pluginSelectorParams: SharedComponentParam[]` — parameter tables for shared components

### Code String Properties
All C# code examples are stored as `readonly string` properties on the component class to avoid Angular ICU message parsing issues with curly braces (`{`/`}`). These are bound via `{{ propertyName }}` interpolation inside `<pre><code>` blocks. Properties include:
- `idisplayServiceCode` — IDisplayService interface
- `ishortcutCode` — IShortcut interface
- `itoolbarComponentCode` — IToolbarComponent + ToolbarAlignment enum
- `iviewStartProviderCode` — IViewStartProvider interface
- `kernelComponentBaseCode` — KernelComponentBase class
- `viewStartCode` — ViewStart class
- `kernelInjectAttributeCode` — KernelInjectAttribute class
- `kernelInjectUsageCode` — Usage example with [KernelInject]
- `componentOptionsCode` — ComponentOptions + ComponentMetaData
- `componentOptionsExtensionsCode` — ComponentOptionsExtensions class
- `codeLanguagesCode` — CodeLanguages class
- `cyrenaBuilderExtensionsCode` — CyrenaBuilderExtensions class
- `cyrenaKernelBuilderExtensionsCode` — CyrenaKernelBuilderExtensions class
- `componentBaseExtensionsCode` — ComponentBaseExtensions class
- `toolbarExampleCode` — Toolbar component example
- `shortcutExampleCode` — Shortcut example
- `settingsExampleCode` — Settings component registration example
- `viewStartExampleCode` — ViewStart provider example

### Styling
Pure Bootstrap CSS — no custom component CSS. Uses:
- `h1 fw-bold mb-4`, `h2 fw-bold mb-4`, `h3 h5 fw-bold mt-4` for headings
- `lead text-secondary mb-5` for lead paragraphs
- `alert alert-info` for namespace info box
- `pre class="bg-dark text-light p-3 rounded"` for code blocks (content bound from component properties)
- `table table-bordered` for all tables
- `badge bg-secondary` for "Kernel-locked" labels
- `text-secondary` for body text and lists

### Notes
- Package version (`0.5.0`) and target framework (`.NET 10.0`) displayed in overview
- All `<pre>` blocks bind code from component string properties instead of inline HTML to avoid Angular ICU parsing errors with curly braces
- `IViewStartProvider` contract and `ViewStart` model documented
- `KernelInjectAttribute` documented with usage example
- Package Information table at bottom with metadata
